prompt: Define functions $f_0,f_1,\dots,f_n,\dots$ to satisfy the following relations: $f_0=2$, $\frac{d}{dx}f_n=f_{n-1}$. If for $n\ge1$, $f_n(0)=0$, compute $$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}f_n(\ln 2019).$$

solutions.title: Taylor series of $e^x$
solutions.body:
By induction $f_n(x)=\frac{2x^n}{n!}$ (it has derivative $\frac{2x^{n-1}}{(n-1)!}=f_{n-1}$ and vanishes at $0$). So $\sum_{n\ge0}f_n(\ln2019)=2\sum_{n\ge0}\frac{(\ln2019)^n}{n!}=2e^{\ln2019}=4038$.

**Answer: 4038**

solutions.title: Leading terms
solutions.body:
$\sin(2x)\sim2x$ and $e^x\to1$, so the quotient behaves like $\frac{x^{10}}{(2x)^{10}}=\frac1{2^{10}}$, and the limit is $\frac1{1024}$. (Precisely: $\frac{x^{10}e^x}{\sin^{10}2x}=e^x\left(\frac{x}{\sin2x}\right)^{10}\to1\cdot\left(\frac12\right)^{10}$.)

**Answer: $\frac1{1024}$**

solutions.title: Integral of an inverse function
solutions.body:
For an increasing function $f$ with inverse $f^{-1}$, $\int_a^bf(x)\,dx+\int_{f(a)}^{f(b)}f^{-1}(x)\,dx=bf(b)-af(a)$ (the two areas fill the rectangle minus a corner rectangle). Here $f(x)=\ln(x^7+1)$ has inverse $f^{-1}(x)=\sqrt[7]{e^x-1}$, with $a=0$, $b=10$, $f(10)=\ln(10^7+1)$. So the sum is $10\ln(10^7+1)-0=10\ln(10000001)$.

**Answer: $10\ln(10^7+1)$**
